role: FOK (Feeling of Knowing) feasibility check for semantic queries — lightweight metacognitive probe that gates expensive query execution
detail: Implements FOK as a deterministic, fast feasibility check that runs before query execution (Phase 1.8-E3/T011). Core classes: FOKProbeResult (frozen dataclass encoding feasibility decision, edge metrics, timing); FOKAccuracyTracker (session-scoped 4-counter tracker for TP/FP/TN/FN with accuracy/precision/recall properties). Main functions: compute_fok_probe_depth() computes dynamic probe depth with E5 gating (min(FOK_PROBE_MAX=4, current_depth+1), capped at FOK_E3_DEPTH_CAP=3 if e5_prerequisite_met=False); three per-query-type checkers (fok_check_definition, fok_check_classification, fok_check_inference) that execute lightweight Cypher count queries; unified async dispatcher fok_check() that reads EvolutionRule config then routes to appropriate checker. Probes count semantic edges within bounded hop distance, check confidence >= FOK_MIN_CONFIDENCE=0.3 on at least one edge, require edge_count >= FOK_MIN_EDGE_COUNT=1. For inference queries, feasibility requires structure on both subject (outgoing) and target (incoming) sides. Returns FOKProbeResult with feasibility bool, edge counts, max confidence, distinct edge types, probe depth used, elapsed time, human-readable reason, and whether depth was capped by E5 gating. Logs all checks at DEBUG; returns (0, 0.0, 0) or (0, 0.0) on Cypher errors.
gotchas: fok_check() is async because it awaits GraphPersistence.get_node() for EvolutionRule config, but Cypher probes themselves are synchronous; unknown query_type defaults feasible=True with warning log to avoid blocking future query types; _run_fok_probe_cypher uses ALL(rel IN relationships(path)) to enforce confidence and valid_to IS NULL on every edge in path; _run_fok_target_probe_cypher is single-hop incoming check for inference targets only; accuracy tracker assumes false_negatives are unobserved when FOK blocks (estimated via shadow probes at DEBUG level only); no persistence or graph writes from FOK itself (session-scoped metrics only)
